methodology: Mutually exclusive observed loss, not causal proof. All answerable cases stay in accuracy denominators; missing/uncertain judges never count as correct. Answer correctness is same-model post-hoc judgment, not independently validated. Joint judge memory/retrieval labels were found confounded and excluded from stage attribution. Paragraph control attribution uses actual gold paragraph links/full text. Missing one gold set does not prove no equivalent evidence existed, and whole paragraph visibility does not prove sufficient reading. Organization errors are not separately blamed without evidence from facet ablation.
